_about: cadState of a COMPLETED response (camelCase; source: Models/CadState.cs). GET /api/tool/state returns the current stateVersion.
stateVersion: integer: starts at 0 when the server starts, +1 per completed mutating call
activeDocument: string (title) or omitted when no document is open
documentType: PART | ASSEMBLY | DRAWING | OTHER, omitted with no document
features: array of strings: the feature(s) the call created, or a read tool's items; an analyze_* payload is ONE JSON-object string here (the adapter inlines it as JSON)
dimensions: array of strings: applied dimensions; a multi-format export_document lists partial failures here
